evidence.quote: To send messages to an encrypted queue, the producer must have the kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt permissions for the CMK.
evidence.title: Amazon SQS FAQs | Message Queuing Service | AWS

evidence.quote: Therefore, the producer must have the `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey` permissions for the KMS key.

qualifiers.scope: producer of an SSE-KMS queue, per KMS key
qualifiers.condition: CONFLICT kept open on purpose: the SQS documentation history row of July 24, 2024 (sqs-change-sendmessage-needs-only-generatedatakey-2024) says SendMessage no longer requires kms:Decrypt; the FAQ and the current key-management page still say a producer needs both. Granting both permissions to a producer is the design that works under either reading.

note: d029, d114. Registrar register-31 kept this fact and added the key-management page as a second source; the book should teach: grant a producer kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt, and mention the 2024 history row as a Changed recently note.
